yeoju.historicalWeight: Yeoju carries Joseon royal memory through King Sejong's tomb and river-side temple culture around Silleuksa. Its position along the Namhan River makes it a natural first threshold after leaving Seoul's density.
yeoju.modernIdentity: Today Yeoju also works as a Seoul-adjacent escape with ceramics, outlet shopping, riverside leisure, and a softer suburban-to-regional rhythm before the trip commits to deeper inland movement.
yeoju.routeMeaning: Yeoju is a junction city because it can send the traveler south-inland toward Chungju or east-inland toward Wonju. It should read as the first place where Seoul loosens and the route has a real choice.
yeoju.imageBrief: Use Namhan River, Silleuksa or royal-tomb imagery, ceramics or outlet-present-day cues, and a map that shows the split toward Chungju and Wonju.
